protocol: Three arms: fixed multiply closure, unrelated double lesson, cumulative square/fourth/eighth lessons. Supplied call/repeat/range grammar. No primitive discovery or source rewriting. Final tests run after all learning.
budget: Per search: 2 nodes, 3000 candidates, 40000 candidate cases, 5 seconds, 8000 cache entries. Total: 120 seconds including pauses; 512 MiB sampled process working set. Single worker.
acceptance: Training-consistent candidates retained provisionally in isolated arm. Report every held-out failure and retest addition/multiplication. No promotion into the main library.
